name: Mystic Preparation
body:
School divination; Level bard 3, cleric/oracle 3, druid 3, fateshaper 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, psychic 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, unchained summoner 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Effect you
Duration 10 min./level (D)

You gain an innate sense of magic occurring in your vicinity. You become automatically aware of a spell or spell-like ability being cast within 100 feet of you, so long as you have line of effect to the caster. You gain an automatic attempt to identify the spell with a +5 bonus to your Spellcraft check.

If you succeed on this check, you can discharge this spell as an immediate action to attempt to dispel the spell you identified, if you have a spell available to counter the spell. You do not need to see the spellcaster to counterspell, so long as you have line of effect.
